name: GlobalSecureAccessOnboard
label: Onboard Global Secure Access
helpText: Onboards the tenant to Microsoft's Global Secure Access service - the prerequisite for every other Global Secure Access standard. Onboarding alone routes no traffic: nothing flows through the service until a traffic profile is enabled and the client is deployed, but it is a one-way door - there is no offboard API and reversing it requires Microsoft support - so enable it deliberately. Requires a Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2 license.
executiveText: Registers the tenant with Microsoft's cloud network security service, the required first step before secure routing and compliant-network sign-in controls can be configured. No staff traffic is redirected by this step alone.
docsDescription: Grades the onboarding flag from the NetworkAccess cache (onboarded). Remediation reads the live tenant status, starts onboarding with POST /networkAccess/microsoft.graph.networkaccess.onboard when the tenant is not onboarded, waits out the asynchronous onboarding window, and reports the API's own error when an earlier onboarding failed. A tenant still settling when the window ends is re-verified by the next run.
